Interface PlatformRecord

All Known Implementing Classes:
AuditEntryRecord
public interface PlatformRecord
The current state of one row that the reporting service shows and an order status event does not carry. A service raises one inside the transaction that wrote the row, and PlatformRecordPublisher sends it to Kafka once that transaction has committed.

An implementation is the message body: serialised as JSON it carries its own components, and the publisher adds type. It holds plain values, not entities, because it is handled after the transaction and outside any persistence context. It must never carry an SSN, an address, a date of birth or a password hash.

      Names the kind of row, for example ORDER_AUDIT. Sent as the body's type and as the first half of the message key.
      Returns:
      the record type

    • recordId

      String recordId()
      Identifies the row among others of its type. The second half of the message key, so a later state of the same row replaces an earlier one when the topic is compacted.
      Returns:
      the row's identifier as text
